reuseBoundary: Only pure review templates changed after the45-case cohort. Twelve review/creation/recurring/decimal cases passed afterwards; the three obsolete origin text assertions were replaced by explicit label/value checks. Final nine cases cover both acquisition-origin paths and explicit catalogue adoption with observation and urgency. Other30 runtime paths and all native handlers,APIs,SQL,auth and ledger contracts remained identical.

checks.reference: offline canonical HTML computed styles;existing unchanged modal/header/tab foundation
checks.forcedColors: Canvas/CanvasText header correction;all axe rules enabled;media assertions active
checks.sqlOracle: native snapshots of requisitions,documents and ledger;existing decimal,origin,science,parcel and closure assertions preserved

counterproofs: Initial fixture tried to change precision after stock history;fixture corrected without weakening native immutability.
Selected product background differed from canonical HTML before implementation.
Two new test selectors did not match existing accessible names.
Forced colors exposed three header contrast failures;system colors corrected them.
Canonical definition grid separated acquisition label/value;old combined-text selectors updated without changing ledger/origin assertions.

remote.dryRun: Remote database is up to date.

limits: No new approval of the105 original acceptance statuses or18 UI requirement states.
DOC-A/B/C/D unchanged;no PDF appearance,autonomous return,20-minute access policy,cancellation science or simplified draft completion claimed.
Whole-page review captures are contextual:fixed navigation may appear inside the stitched image;card/table crops and computed-style comparisons are the scoped visual evidence.
Human,screen reader,native400%,physical Android/PWA andprovider gates remain.
Own published SHA CI and protected Preview observation required.
